hook: *24-hour* water cut in Suraram and Saibaba Nagar from 9 pm tonight
hook_b: *24-hour* water cut in Suraram and Saibaba Nagar from 9 pm tonight
tldr: HMWSSB will disrupt supply from 9 pm on Nov 21 to 9 pm on Nov 22 in parts of Suraram and Saibaba Nagar wards while it replaces a 700 mm drinking-water pipeline on Suraram main road.

beats.what: Supply stops or runs at low pressure in Vishwakarma Colony, Vaishnavi Nagar, Vemareddy Nagar, Lakshmi Nagar, Suraram village, Telugu Thalli Nagar, Jai Bheem Nagar, Maitri Nagar and Suraram Colony.
beats.why: An 800 mm sewage line from Suraram lake to the 14 MLD treatment plant in Shivalaya Nagar needs a 700 mm water pipeline moved on Suraram main road.
beats.care: Store water before 9 pm tonight; HMWSSB asks residents to use water sparingly.
